transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got the feature screening coming up, and I'd like to get the venue operating plan finalized. Before I can approve the daily run sheet, we need to hold our routine technical and safety huddle. I'd like the projection supervisor and the safety and insurance coordinator to walk through the current draft with me — Hall A, 180 audience members, Q&A recording for the archive, and standard two-way audience movement. Who's ready to start that review?
